description: This file implements asynchronous subscription management for RBUS, including handling retries, thread management, and subscription lifecycle functions.

classes.name: AsyncSubscribeRetrier_t
classes.description: Structure managing the retry list, synchronization primitives, and thread state for asynchronous subscriptions.

classes.name: AsyncSubscription_t
classes.description: Structure representing an individual subscription, its payload, and retry timing information.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribeRetrier_FreeSubscription
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a subscription item.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribeRetrier_CompareHandle
methods.description: Compares a subscription handle with a list item.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribeRetrier_CompareSubscription
methods.description: Compares a subscription with a list item based on handle, event name, and filter.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribeRetrier_DetermineNextSendTime
methods.description: Determines the next time subscriptions should be retried based on their scheduled retry times.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribeRetrier_SendSubscriptionRequests
methods.description: Attempts to send subscription requests for due subscriptions and manages retries.

methods.name: AsyncSubscribeRetrier_threadFunc
methods.description: Main thread function managing the retry loop and timing.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribeRetrier_Create
methods.description: Initializes the retrier structure, mutex, condition variable, and starts the thread.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribeRetrier_Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up and terminates the retrier thread and resources.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribe_AddSubscription
methods.description: Adds a new subscription to the retry list and signals the retrier thread.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribe_RemoveSubscription
methods.description: Removes a subscription from the retry list.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribe_GetSubscription
methods.description: Checks if a subscription exists for given handle, event name, and filter.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribe_CloseHandle
methods.description: Closes all subscriptions associated with a handle and destroys the retrier if no subscriptions remain.
